notes.title: BIG UPDATE | ESCAPE FROM IRENE
notes.notes:
I got sick while working on the new patch, but everything is fine now.
I hope you all will love this update!

New Trailer for update: https://youtu.be/X60xriYaAjs
 
What's new in 3.0 Escape From Irene?
**Add**
• 13 Achievements
• Change way to Interact with Irene [b]BIG CHANGE[/b]
• Change timer calculation in Escape Gameplay [b]BIG CHANGE[/b]
• Add Status to interaction on player [b]BIG CHANGE[/b]
• Add Irene Heart
• Add a new 7-slide puzzle
• Add SecretScene with Irene
• Add 3 New puzzles for guide point
• Add Skip Chapter Phase1 for the player who's Game over
• Add New Monster Miss RIPYOURFACE
• Add New Monster Mister RIPYOURHEART
• Add Guide Hint button for player stuckling
• Add Note
• Add Knock Icon
• Add Detail in note Knocking Puzzle
• Add hint in the note
• Monsters are now with you till you solve the puzzle
• Whisper New Gameplay
• Baby New Gameplay
• Extra Ending
• Add a setting bar in the pause menu
**Fixed**
• Cut some dialogue and focus more on engage
• Ending Escape Door Softlock
• Ending Live Softlock
• Smile Irene face glitch
• Observer Softlock
• Change Gameplay Note Music Puzzle
• Wrong Hint Position Mark In Night4 Room
• Fix Vase Night1 Image out of bound
